server_name.description: The name of the ProFTPD server as reported to clients and used in identification.

user.description: The user ID under which ProFTPD processes will run.

group.description: The group ID under which ProFTPD processes will run.

default_address.description: The IP address ProFTPD binds to for incoming connections.

port.description: The TCP port number ProFTPD listens on for FTP connections.

log_dir.description: The directory path where ProFTPD log files are stored.

listen_address.description: The specific address to listen on for the default VirtualHost.

vhost_server_name.description: The ServerName directive for the default VirtualHost.

vhost_root.description: The default root directory (chroot or path) for the default VirtualHost.

anon_path.description: The directory path for the anonymous FTP login.

anon_user.description: The user identity for anonymous FTP access.

anon_group.description: The group identity for anonymous FTP access.

server_ident.description: The identification string sent in response to FEAT commands and welcome messages.
